title: Consolidate toggle buttons into one base class

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

The `CheckButton` was a near carbon copy of the `CheckBox` class (only really changing the default alignment of the button icon itself) and the `CheckBox` was simultaneously used for a `RadioButton` rather than the two being seen as independent buttons. This PR consolidates the code into a single `ToggleButton` base class and creates the `CheckButton`, `CheckBox` and `RadioButton` as child classes of it which all have slightly different default themes and their own icons.

These buttons now also support more styling options similar to #120766. I choice to consolidate these three button types to avoid triple duplicating the code but that does mean that this will be a breaking change.

Additionally, I added a new theme constant `button_on_right` to align the button on either the left or right side. By default these are on the left side with the exception of the `CheckButton` where it defaults to `1` so it aligns to the right side. When the layout mode is set to 'right to left' they still switch sides accordingly.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/836f3810-cc2d-456e-b2b3-f89cefb603a8

## Breaking changes

* When a `CheckBox` has a `ButtonGroup` assigned, it will still behave accordingly but will no longer automatically visually become a radio button. Instead the `RadioButton` class must be used to get the default styling (the `ProjectDialog` options for the renderer have been updated, all other places where a button group was used seem to be for flat buttons instead and thus wouldn't have the radio button styling to begin with).
* The `radio_checked`, `radio_unchecked`, `radio_checked_disabled` and `radio_unchecked_disabled` theme options for the `CheckBox` have been removed and you should instead use `checked`, `unchecked`, `checked_disabled`, `unchecked_disabled` on any of the `ToggleButton` child classes.

## Additional information

Whilst it might look like a big PR, the majority of the changes are in updating the include statement for the new toggle_button header file. The real meat of this PR lies in `ToggleButton` class along with the default theme updates and documentation.

I looked at the `Slider` and `HSlider`/`VSlider` classes for reference on how to do this as it's a very similar usecase.

The new `RadioButton` icon is simply the `GuiRadioChecked` svg with the color changed to the same green color as the other control items. The `ToggleButton` is simply the same as the `CheckBox` icon

Here's a test project to see the new styling options in action: [guitest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29603667/guitest.zip)
